run_download_unrealstereo4k: run the script to download and extract the UnrealStereo4K dataset to a target directory
run_download_only: run the script with --stages download to download the UnrealStereo4K dataset without extracting
run_extract_only: run the script with --stages extract to extract downloaded UnrealStereo4K zip archives
run_parallel_download: run the script with --n_workers to control parallel download workers for the UnrealStereo4K dataset
run_download_to_custom_extract_dir: run the script with --extract_dir to extract UnrealStereo4K archives to a custom directory
